title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Plastics
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which type of plastic cannot be softened or remolded once it has set?
questions.explain: Thermosetting plastics undergo a chemical change during curing and become permanently hard. They cannot be remelted.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of a Thermoplastic material?
questions.explain: Nylon, PVC, and Polythene are thermoplastics (can be melted). Bakelite and Urea formaldehyde are thermosets.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
